next.description: `kind/key` to pass as `after` for the next page.

reason.description: Required: missing or blank answers REASON_REQUIRED.

lsn.description: 0 for dry runs and unchanged deploys.

reason.description: Why, as recorded with the deployment.

token_id.description: Who: `token:<name>`, or `unix:uid=<n>` on the socket without a token.

Diff.description: A behavior diff: how a fork's code behaves on main's root inputs, next to production (docs/design/m3-fork.md §5). The same fork, code and options always give the same bytes. `kronik diff show --md` and `format=md` render the same diff as Markdown.

causes.description: Sorted by origins descending, then kind, then input.

code.description: The code of every changed actor kind, before (production) and after (the fork).

fork.description: The fork: `p-<12 hex>` for a proposal, else the name it was created with.

grounding.description: One entry per external target, sorted by kind, host and route.

kinds.description: Each actor kind on its own, sorted by kind: every kind of the fork's code and every kind a replayed turn ran as (M9). Absent from diffs written before M9.

proposal_id.description: The id the daemon keeps the diff under: the proposal's, or the plain fork's name.

Diff.title: kronik.diff/v1

DiffBase.description: Where the fork starts and which root inputs ran.

branch.description: The branch the fork was taken from: `main`.

from_lsn.description: The first main LSN of the window.

to_lsn.description: The last main LSN of the window.

window_cut.description: Present when retention cut the proposal's window short: the window reaches back before the oldest point the log and snapshots still hold, so only the root inputs after `kept_from_lsn` were replayed.

kept_from_lsn.description: The oldest snapshot the log continues; the fork starts there.

window_ms.description: The logical time the proposal asked to replay, back from the newest root input.

path.description: A JSON Pointer (`/a/0/b`); `""` is the whole body.

DiffCause.description: The differences of one actor kind and input.

input.description: The method and route pattern for HTTP (`POST /counter/{key}/{op}`), else `message <name>` or `timer <name>`.

root_inputs.description: Root inputs whose trees differ here.

DiffCumulative.description: Differences only continuous replay shows: actors whose final state differs although no single isolated tree explains it, or whose drift grows.

fields.description: The parts that differ. Secret header values never appear, only their names and version hashes. When the request was recorded under a subject, its url, header and body values appear as `{redacted, subject, hash}` (see DiffValue), like state values.

grounding.description: How the fork's effect was answered.

items.description: Sorted by kind, host, route, then turn; at most 200.

fixed.description: Turns that committed in the fork but failed in production.

introduced.description: Fork turns that fail where production committed, and new turns that fail.

new_orphans.description: Orphaned calls the fork created and production did not.

outcome_unknown.description: Fork effects matched to a production effect whose outcome was unknown.

DiffGroundingRow.description: How the fork's effects to one target were answered. For crypto and secret reveals `method` and `route` are empty and `host` is the secret's name.

route.description: The path with ids replaced by `{}`.

op.description: What the fork did to the key; `unchanged-missing` when it did not write a key that production wrote.

DiffKind.description: One actor kind's share of the diff: the counts of `summary`, `responses`, `effects`, `state` and `errors` over that kind's turns and actors.

actors_changed.description: Actors of this kind whose state differs, in isolated or continuous replay.

code.description: The kind's code in the fork against production's at the fork point; `absent` when neither has code for it (only turns that found no deployed kind ran as it).

divergent_turns.description: This kind's turns that behave differently, both modes counted once by causal key. The kinds' counts add up to `summary.divergent_turns`.

effects.description: External effect differences of this kind's turns.

errors.description: Errors of this kind's turns, as in `errors`.

origins.description: This kind's differing turns whose input is the same as production's.

responses.description: HTTP root inputs served by this kind.

root_inputs.description: Root inputs of the window addressed to an actor of this kind.

turns_fork.description: Fork turns of this kind in the replayed trees.

turns_prod.description: Production turns of this kind in the replayed trees.

DiffOptions.description: The replay options the diff was made with.

fuel_threshold.description: A fuel change below this share is not a change.

ignore_headers.description: Response and effect headers left out of the comparison.

ignore_json_paths.description: Parts of JSON bodies left out of the comparison, as JSONPath (`$.a.b[*].c`).

live_allowlist.description: The `[fork] live_allowlist` hosts in force: a GET without a recording to one of them went out live.

mode.description: Isolated replay (each root input on production's state at its LSN), continuous replay (the fork's state evolves), or both.

no_pii.description: A fork without access to personal data: it ran on pseudonyms (M8).

sample.description: The share of root inputs replayed in isolated mode, in (0, 1].

stubs.description: Canned answers for effects without a recording, tried in order (synthetic grounding).

DiffRatio.description: A share from 0 to 1, with at most 6 decimals.

DiffResources.description: Fuel and memory of matched turns.

fuel_p99_change.description: (fork - prod) / prod at p99; 0.0 when prod is 0.

memory_p99_change.description: (fork - prod) / prod at p99; 0.0 when prod is 0.

body.description: When both bodies are JSON, the operations from production's body to the fork's, by JSON Pointer; otherwise one `replace` at the path `""` with each body as text (or base64).

turn_fork.description: Null when the fork gave no response.

DiffResponses.description: HTTP root inputs in isolated replay.

items.description: The changed responses in root LSN order, at most 200.

DiffSamples.description: Fork turns per category, at most 20 each, for `kronik trace`.

pii_masked.description: Turns counted in `summary.pii_masked`. Absent when empty.

DiffSqlChange.description: A row change. The values of a subject's row (a changeset with a subject, or a `_subject` column in the final state) appear as `[redacted:s:<12 hex>:k:<16 hex>]` (see DiffValue).

continuous.description: Each actor's final state that differs: the fork's store against production at `to_lsn`.

isolated.description: The writes of each root input's tree that differ, at most 200 entries.

DiffStubRule.description: Requests whose method (when given) and URL prefix match get this response, or this error.

method.description: GET, POST, ...; any method when absent.

approximate.description: Fork effects answered by a similar recording (same target, different request).

changed.description: Any difference anywhere in the diff.

confidence.description: exact / (exact + approximate + synthetic + live); 1.0 without effects.

consequences.description: Every other difference in the same causal trees.

divergent_turns.description: Turns that behave differently, both modes counted once by causal key.

exact.description: Fork effects answered by an identical recording.

live.description: Allowlisted GETs that went out live from the fork.

origins.description: Differing turns whose input is the same as production's.

pii_masked.description: In a fork without personal data: differing turns that read pseudonyms instead of personal data, and production turns missing below them. They are not verified: not counted as divergent, errors or causes (M8), and the policy needs at least an approval while pii_masked + pii_unverified is above 0 (pii-masked-needs-approval, ADR 0031). Always written (0 when none); diffs written before v0.1 lack it when 0.

pii_unverified.description: In a fork without personal data: turns of a kind whose code changed that read pseudonyms and came out identical to production. They did not run on the real values either, so they count for the approval floor (ADR 0031). 0 in identity replays. Always written; diffs written before v0.1 lack it.

replayed.description: Root inputs replayed in isolated mode.

sample.description: replayed / root_inputs; 1.0 for an empty window.

synthetic.description: Fork effects with no recording: a stub rule answered, or the effect failed closed.

turns_fork.description: Fork turns of the replayed trees.

turns_prod.description: Production turns of the replayed trees.

verified_through_lsn.description: The last main LSN whose root inputs ran through the fork's code.

DiffTurnId.description: A turn: `main:<lsn>` in production; in the fork `<fork>:<lsn>` (continuous replay) or `<fork>:r<root_lsn>.<n>` (the n-th turn of an isolated tree).

DiffValue.description: A value on one side: a state value, a header, a body or part of one, an SQL row; null when that side has none. A value with a subject is never shown, nor is the subject id: a state value, body or header value is `{"redacted": true, "subject": "s:<12 hex>", "hash": "k:<16 hex>"}`, a value in an SQL row `"[redacted:s:<12 hex>:k:<16 hex>]"`. `s:` is a keyed hash of the subject id (equal subjects give equal ones), `k:` a keyed hash of the subject and the value; both are `-` when the diff was built without the master key (`kronik upgrade check`). In a `--no-pii` fork, what a turn that used SQL produced is redacted under the subject `[sql]`, shown as is.

hint.description: For denied effects: the exact command that grants the capability.

request.description:
In history, for an HTTP effect: the request's method, host and path,
such as `POST api.example.com/hooks`. Omitted otherwise, and when the
request is sealed for a data subject.

status.description:
ok, denied, network, timeout, too_large, outcome_unknown, not_found,
rejected, failed, reentrant.

complete_after_ms.description:
When shipped keystore backups of this erasure expire
(`erased_at + privacy.keystore_backup_retention`, §6.7). For a dry
run, the would-be time.

epoch.description: The `Erasure` record's epoch (the would-be one for a dry run).

key_version.description:
The last erased key version (0: the subject had no key); 0 for a dry
run.

lsn.description: The record's LSN; `null` for a dry run.

plain_values.description:
The subject's values written in `off` mode that are still plain in
the log, until a reseal (§8).

Error.description: The stable error JSON, the same from the API, the CLI's --json and MCP.

hint.description: What to do next, often the exact command.

unavailable.description:
Why this daemon runs no foreign actor (another daemon holds
`run_dir`, or the foreign actors' directory could not be prepared).

status.description: Null for a dry run, or when this daemon does not run foreign actors.

reason.description: Required: missing or blank answers REASON_REQUIRED.

ForkPoint.description: `at`: an LSN, `"now"`, or an RFC 3339 time (logical time).

ForkTurnResponse.description: A turn run in a fork (`POST /v1/forks/{name}/actors/{kind}/{key}/messages`).

delivery.description:
replay-safe, idempotency-keyed or unsafe; the method's default when
absent.

reason.description: Required: missing or blank answers REASON_REQUIRED.
Required: missing or blank answers REASON_REQUIRED.

disk_free_bytes.description:
Free bytes on the log's file system, when `[log] disk_reserve` is
set and read.

low_disk.description:
The log's file system is below `[log] disk_reserve`: new inputs and
changes are refused. Omitted when false.

status.description: `ok` while the node runs (a stopped node answers an error).

next.description: LSN to pass as `before` for the next page.

log_first_lsn.description: The first LSN the log still holds (retention deletes older segments).

log_hash.description:
BLAKE3 over the records `log_first_lsn..=applied_lsn` (LSN, kind and
encoded record of each).

newest_logical_time_ms.description:
Newest record's logical time (`time_hwm`). Zero when the node has
no storage config, or when nothing has advanced logical time.

retention_cutoff_ms.description:
Forks whose turn logical time is strictly before this are outside
the window. Zero when the node has no storage config.

retention_history_ms.description:
`[retention] history` in milliseconds. Zero when the node has no
storage config (`Node::start` with `storage: None`, including DST).
`start_local` and `kronik serve` always install one; the default is
7 days. An older response that omits the field decodes as 0.

subjects.description: Subjects with at least one key.

LastExitView.description: How the last run of a foreign actor ended.

reason.description: Required: missing or blank answers REASON_REQUIRED.

epoch.description: Set in responses to `POST /v1/limits` (lsn 0 for dry runs).

turn_id.description: The callee's turn that made the change.

kind.description:
committed, rejected, failed, trap, fuel_exhausted, memory_limit,
effect_outcome_unknown.

PolicyEvaluation.description: The policy's verdict on a behavior diff.

errors.description: Rules that could not be evaluated; each also counts as fired, with at least require_approval.

fired.description: The rules that fired, in rule order, then pii-masked-needs-approval (a floor in code, ADR 0031) when the diff has pii-masked turns.

reason.description: Why, for the floor in code; absent for rules.

outcome.description: The strictest action among the rules that fired; allow when none did.

reason.description: Required: missing or blank answers REASON_REQUIRED.

proposal.description: The proposal (or fork) whose diff is evaluated.

rules_toml.description: Rules to test; the rules in force when absent.

PrivacyModeName.description: A privacy mode as the API writes it: `"off"` or `"on"`.

changed.description:
False when the mode already was the one asked for; nothing was
recorded.

epoch.description:
The `PrivacyMode` record's configuration epoch (the would-be one for
a dry run); `null` before the first record.

lsn.description: The new record's LSN; `null` for a dry run or when nothing changed.

epoch.description: The latest `PrivacyMode` record's epoch; `null` before the first.

keystore.description: `null` when the daemon runs without a keystore.

pending_erasures.description:
Erasures that still have a plain value in the log (§6.5). The count
names no subject.

reseal.description: Reseal progress (§8). Zero until the first reseal.

kinds.description: The code the proposal switches: one entry per changed actor kind.

unchanged.description:
Components of the request whose code main already ran: skipped, not
in the fork's code (M9).

warnings.description:
What a reader must know about how the proposal was verified, e.g.
that retention cut its window short.

ProposeRequest.description: Replay options shared by fork replay and propose.

names.description:
A name per component, such as its file name, used in error
messages (M9); optional.

no_pii.description:
A fork without access to the privacy keys (propose; a plain fork
keeps the flag it was created with).

reason.description: Required: missing or blank answers REASON_REQUIRED.

stubs.description:
Canned answers for effects without a recording (synthetic
grounding): `[{"method", "url_prefix", "status", "headers",
"body"} | {"url_prefix", "error": "network" | "timeout" |
"too-large" | "denied"}]`.

threads.description: Isolated replay workers (default: the machine's cores, at most 16).

segments.description: Closed segments rewritten, or that a dry run would rewrite.

started.description: False for a dry run, and when no closed segment needed rewriting.

the pre-reseal bytes.

pending_segments.description: Rewritten segments not yet replaced in object storage.

reason.description: Required: missing or blank answers REASON_REQUIRED.

version_hash.description: Hex of the keyed version hash; never the value.

reason.description: `interval`, `shutdown` or `manual`.

shipped.description:
True when this snapshot's LSN is recorded in `<data_dir>/ship.json`.
False when shipping is off or the snapshot has not been uploaded.
Missing on an older response decodes as false.

state_hash.description: BLAKE3 over the materialized state at `lsn` (m6-storage §8).

StateEntry.description:
Bytes as JSON: `text` when valid UTF-8 (responses), and always `base64`.
Requests give either one.

subject.description: The value's subject; null for a caller without `pii:read`.

id.description: Decimal string: the u64 does not fit a JSON number exactly.

name.description:
A lowercase letter, then up to 62 lowercase letters, digits and
dashes; never reused.

reason.description: Required: missing or blank answers REASON_REQUIRED.

secret.description:
The bearer token. It is returned only here, once, and never stored;
absent for dry runs.

reason.description: Required: missing or blank answers REASON_REQUIRED.

token_id.description: How the token's actions are recorded: `token:<name>`.

TraceNode.description: One node of a causal tree (`GET /v1/turns/{id}/trace`).

ancestors.description: From the root input down to the turn's parent.

descendants.description: What the turn caused, as a tree (at most 1000 turns).

root.description: The tree's root input (absent when it is outside the log).

Turn.description: A turn record as JSON (`GET /v1/turns/{id}`): what one actor did with one input, as the log holds it. A caller without the `pii:read` scope sees a sealed value as `[sealed]`, every `subject` as null, and gets SCOPE_MISSING for a turn of a fork made without `--no-pii`; an erased value reads `[erased]`; secret values never appear.

causal_id.description: The causal key in short, as the guest sees it: 32 hex characters.

causal_key.description: The root input and the path of messages that led here.

compensations.description: Messages delivered because the turn failed after a successful call.

config_epoch.description: The epoch of the configuration (code, grants, secrets) the turn ran under.

engine_version.description: The versions of Kronik and Wasmtime that ran it: `kronik-<version>+wasmtime-<version>`.

logical_time_ms.description: The turn's logical clock, in Unix milliseconds.

lsn.description: The log position; 0 for a turn of an isolated tree.

messages.description: Messages sent, delivered after the commit.

output.description: The reply to a message or the HTTP response; null when there is none.

schema_version.description: The actor's state schema version after the turn.

turn_id.description: `main:<lsn>`; in a fork `<fork>:<lsn>` (continuous replay) or `<fork>:r<root_lsn>.<n>` (the n-th turn of an isolated tree).

Turn.title: Turn

path.description: One step per message from the root input to this turn.

root.description: The root input's id: 32 hex characters.

TurnEffect.description: An effect: what it called and how it ended. Requests and responses are not shown.

hint.description: For a denied effect: the command that grants the capability.

idempotency_key.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header; empty when there is none.

params.description: The route's parameters, as `[name, value]` pairs.

query.description: Without the `?`; empty when there is none.

TurnMessageInput.description: A message: from another actor, `kronik send`, a dead-letter resend, a compensation or a call.

reason.description: For an operator message: the `--reason` given.

resend_of.description: For a dead-letter resend, the message id it resends; else empty.

sender.description: The sending actor; null for operator messages and resends.

token_id.description: For an operator message: who sent it, an API token's id or `unix:uid=<uid>` for the Unix socket.

TurnMigrateInput.description: A state migration after a deploy with a new schema version.

TurnPayload.description: Bytes: always `base64`, and `text` when they are UTF-8.

TurnSealable.description: A value that may belong to a data subject.

id.description: Decimal: the u64 does not fit a JSON number exactly.

name.description: The message the timer delivers; null for a cancel.

erased.description:
The value was sealed for a subject that has been erased since: it
reads as `[erased]` (docs/design/m8-privacy.md §5). Omitted when
false.

subject.description: The value's subject; null for a caller without `pii:read`.

bearer.description: A token from `kronik token create`; required over TCP, optional on the Unix socket.

info.description: The daemon's API, versioned under /v1, on the Unix socket and, with a bearer token, over TCP (`--api-listen`). Every mutation requires `reason` and takes `dry_run`; every error is the stable error JSON. `x-kronik-scope` is the scope an operation needs; without a token, the socket's caller has every scope.
